title: "Git under the hood": content-addressed bundle commit + semantic changelog

design_note.summary: Pure-core content-addressed commit mechanism for the authoring bundle. The hash function is injected via BundleHashPort (same injected-port pattern as T-0118 KeyedDigest / ResolverDeps). The pure core (bundle-commit.ts) never imports node:crypto; SHA-256 lives in the adapter (bundle-commit-store.ts). Commits chain parent→child exactly like git objects. The semantic changelog (deriveSemanticChangelog → SemanticChange[]) exposes only human-readable member/kind/summary — never raw hashes — per ADR §7 'outward = semantic changelog'.
design_note.hash_seam: BundleHashPort interface in src/core/bundle-commit.ts (pure); makeSha256Port() factory in src/core/bundle-commit-store.ts (impure, owns node:crypto). Same injected-port pattern as T-0118 makeKeyedDigest + KeyedDigest in keyed-digest.ts. See docs/design/T-0118-hash-oracle.adr.md §2 and §4.1 for the precedent.
design_note.determinism: canonicalCommitPreimage: length-prefixed concatenation of (parent_hash, author, message, committed_at, snapshot.*). Same field order, same bytes → same hash. Mirror of audit-preimage.ts canonicalPreimage construction (length-prefix framing). GENESIS_PARENT_HASH = '0' * 64 (same convention as GENESIS_PREV_HASH in audit-preimage.ts).

t0118_reuse.seam: BundleHashPort in bundle-commit.ts mirrors KeyedDigest interface in keyed-digest.ts. Pure core calls injected hash fn; impure adapter owns node:crypto. canonicalCommitPreimage uses the same length-prefix framing as audit-preimage.ts canonicalPreimage and keyed-digest.ts canonicalPreimage.
t0118_reuse.departure: T-0118 keyed digest is HMAC-SHA256 (secret-keyed) for masking. T-0083 uses unkeyed SHA-256 for content-addressing — correct for this use case: same bundle bytes should always produce the same address (no secret involved, pure content identity).
